item.title: Steve Smith's neck injury forces extended layoff, Cricket Australia reveals return timeline
item.description: Australian batter Steve Smith has been ruled out of selection until the home Test series against New Zealand in December after scans confirmed a cervical facet joint injury in his neck. Cricket Australia revealed the extent of Smith's injury after he was forced to withdraw from the third Test against South Africa in Cape Town, which began on Tuesday. The 37-year-old experienced neck pain on the fourth day of the second Test in Gqeberha last week and was subsequently ruled unfit for the series decider. "Steve Smith developed neck pain on day four of the second Test in Gqeberha last week," Cricket Australia said in a statement. "Subsequent MRI imaging confirmed a cervical facet joint injury. Due to this and his limited range of motion, he was unfit to participate in the current Test." Smith will continue with treatment and rehabilitation, with Australia expecting him to be available again for the New Zealand series at home in December. "Steve will continue to receive treatment and rehabilitation, with a full return to availability anticipated for the upcoming home Test series against New Zealand," the statement added. Inglis makes an immediate impact In Smith's absence, Josh Inglis was brought into the side and made the most of his opportunity, scoring an unbeaten 85 as Australia reached 330/4 in reply to South Africa's first-innings total of 329. The hosts held a slender one-run lead at the close. Matt Renshaw contributed 74, while Cameron Green scored 65 and Alex Carey remained unbeaten on 51. Marnus Labuschagne, however, endured another disappointing outing, departing for a duck. South Africa had earlier been bowled out for 329 after Australia elected to field first. Aiden Markram scored 78, Marques Ackermann made 95 and Marco Jansen added 52 before Mitchell Starc claimed six wickets for 72 runs to wrap up the innings. The Cape Town Test marked Inglis' first appearance in the longest format since he played against England in Adelaide during the Ashes series at the end of last year. Renshaw praised his team-mate's response after Australia lost two quick wickets, saying Inglis' positive approach had helped the side regain momentum. "He is a very talented player, we have seen that across a lot of the white-ball formats," Renshaw said. "To come in today, we were under a little bit of pressure, having lost two quick wickets, and the way that he played was really positive – it was a very Josh innings, and I think it was really what we needed at that time," he added.

item.title: Marlins’ 2026 Awards Show Promise Despite Missing Playoffs
item.description: Credit: Jasen Vinlove-USA TODAY Sports The Miami Marlins missed the postseason by eight games, yet their players are already grabbing national attention. This team has real talent that deserves recognition, even if the final record falls short. It is a sign of progress that three different players are now in the running for major awards. Defensive Stars Shine Bright One of the three National League Gold Glove finalists at third base is Javier Sanoja. He faces tough competition from Alex Bregman and Max Muncy, but Sanoja has a track record. He won the utility player award last year, and his defensive runs saved total five. Rawlings will announce the winners on Sunday night during an ESPN broadcast. His teammate Otto Lopez had a massive year at shortstop that cannot be ignored. Lopez led all qualifying National League shortstops with a .305 batting average and 34 stolen bases. He also played a career-high 157 games and led the entire Majors with 191 hits. His speed and consistency made him a key piece of the lineup all season. Pitching Staff Finds Its Groove Sandy Alcantara is back to his dominant self after a rough recovery in 2025. He led all of Major League Baseball with 214 innings pitched and threw 3,293 total pitches. He tied for first in the league with 33 starts and showed he can still carry the rotation. Marlins president of baseball operations Peter Bendix knows the team needs to win more games next year. He told the media after the season ended that the club is not satisfied with falling short. “That said, I’m also very proud of our team, our organization,” Bendix said. He admitted the club must figure out how to get from contention to the postseason in 2027. The front office faces hard choices about contracts and roster moves this winter. Sports Illustrated reports the team might have to decide on Alcantara’s $21 million option for next year. They also need to address the future of Kyle Stowers, who has shown great potential but struggles with hamstring injuries. Room to Grow Before 2027 Bendix admitted there is work to do before the team can win a division title. He noted that the goal is to go deep into October and repeat that success every year. “There are always things that we can do better,” Bendix said. The team needs to improve defense at first base and right field to reach that next level. With Lopez leading in hits and Sanoja guarding the hot corner, the foundation is solid.

item.title: WWE offered major sacrifice to help Dream host WNBA Finals Game 6 in primetime
item.description: Photo by Matthew Huang/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images The WWE almost helped the Atlanta Dream host Game 6 of the WNBA Finals on the best stage possible, even willing to make a major sacrifice to help the WNBA. The WNBA ultimately decided that hosting Game 6 of the WNBA Finals at 12:30 p.m. (ET) would be the best way to move forward without inconveniencing multiple parties, but fans argue the afternoon timeslot undersells the importance of a potentially close-out game. Among the options the WNBA considered to help Game 6 be hosted in State Farm Arena, one of them was made possible because the WWE offered up a major sacrifice on one of their flagship shows The WWE were willing to reschedule their event for the WNBA Finals ESPN revealed that Hawks and State Farm Arena CEO Steve Koonin reached out to WWE President Nick Khan to move the live broadcast of Friday Night Smackdown on October 30 to 9 p.m. ET so that the WNBA Finals could take place in the primetime 7-9 p.m. slot, something Khan agreed to do. “Khan told him they’d be fine with the later broadcast window if that’s what was needed to help the WNBA Finals play in a more appropriate arena.” Friday Night Smackdown airs at 8 p.m. on the USA Network, the same broadcast partners for Game 6 of the WNBA Finals. The WWE agreeing to move their broadcast to one hour later gave the WNBA a window to schedule a primetime evening game, but other concerns made them stick to Thursday afternoon. With Game 7 currently scheduled for October 31, the WNBA did not want to enter a situation where they move Game 6 to October 30 and be forced to move Game 7 to November 3 and clash with election night in the U.S. Given all the options emerging, it seems the 12:30 p.m. tip-off on October 29 was the best choice for the WNBA to remain operationally streamlined. Moving multiple NBA games at the start of their schedule would prove to be more challenging, since it concerns other teams outside the Hawks as well, so the current solution seems to be the best, despite the WWE’s best efforts. item.title: Creator of Mao Zedong-Kylian Mbappé meme says he ‘feels sorry’ for France captain
item.description: Creator of Mao Zedong-Kylian Mbappé meme says he ‘feels sorry’ for France captain The creator of the Mao Zedong x Kylian Mbappé meme has told Le Parisien that he “feels sorry” for the France captain, whose comments on said meme have landed him in political turmoil. Appearing on The Bridge, Mbappé referred to Mao Zedong, China’s former chairman, as a “dictator”. He has faced significant backlash in China for the comment. Energy drink company Dongpeng and dairy producer Meigniu both announced the termination of their sponsorship deals with Mbappé, stating that his “ behaviour offends national sentiment ”. Real Madrid and La Liga may also face financial repercussions. Reports in China have stated that games featuring Mbappé will not be broadcast in the country. That is despite apologies being made by Mbappé, La Liga, and Real Madrid. A spokesperson for China’s Foreign Affairs Minister said that Mbappé’s apology was being “taken seriously” . Younes Khelifi, who runs the X account Frenchaicovers, is the creator of the original meme. He has now spoken to Le Parisien: “I had seen the video on Monday evening and I was so happy that Mbappé said that it was his favourite [meme]. It made me happy, but I didn’t think that it would cross borders and create a diplomatic incident. It’s completely insane. “At the time, during the summer of 2023, Mbappé was the centre of attention for renewing his contract at PSG. It was said that there was distrust towards him in the dressing room, and that he was holding the club hostage a bit. I watch a bit of football and I am a developer. I was interested in deepfakes and AI for making humorous videos, so these two things came together and I made this video “I didn’t want to offend the whole public […] I feel sorry for Mbappé. The fact that he has to go through so much because of a blunder, that he loses sponsors and potential fans, too, is sad. He is taking too much relative to the seriousness of the topic,” said Khelifi. item.title: England forward Toney to stand trial for alleged assault in June 2028
item.description: England forward Ivan Toney arriving for an earlier court hearing (Brook Mitchell) England striker Ivan Toney will face trial over an alleged assault at a nightclub in June 2028, it was announced Thursday. The 30-year-old, who plays for Saudi club Al-Ahli, is accused of headbutting and punching Saber Da Silva at a club in the Soho area of central London last December. Toney appeared at London's Southwark Crown Court on Thursday and formally entered a not guilty plea to a charge of assault occasioning actual bodily harm. During the five-minute hearing, a provisional trial date was set for the same court on June 12, 2028 by Judge Christopher Hehir, who told Toney he was "sorry" about the delay. "That's a long way in advance and I'm sorry about that," said Hehir. "As you may know, the crown courts are operating under a great deal of pressure. We have got a massive backlog of work for various reasons." Toney was released on unconditional bail after the brief hearing. An earlier hearing was told the alleged assault happened at the 100 Wardour Street club during a confrontation between the defendant and Da Silva. It was heard the two men "squared up to each other", before Toney allegedly "lunged forward and headbutted the complainant, followed by a few punches". The former Brentford player has played for England 10 times, scoring one goal. He was a member of the 2026 World Cup squad but is not in the latest Nations League squad. jdg/lp

item.title: Harry Kane admits knighthood would feel ‘weird’ after Ballon d’Or triumph
item.description: Fresh from claiming the Ballon d’Or following a stellar year for club and country, England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane has admitted that while he would be "massively proud" to receive a knighthood , it would feel "weird" to have everyone calling him Sir. The forward, who collected the honour on Monday night, has been given odds of 3-1 by bookmaker William Hill to be knighted by 2030. Discussing the prospect of a knighthood after Bayern’s DFB-Pokal victory against Magdeburg, Kane told reporters: "I wouldn’t say no to it, that’s for sure. "If it happens it’ll be incredible, and something I’ll be massively proud of. But I don’t want to get too carried away." When asked how he would feel about being Sir Harry Kane, he responded: "It would sound good, but I’d feel weird everyone calling me Sir. So we’ll just keep it as Harry for now." Kane returned to the Allianz Arena to a hero's welcome from the adoring Bayern Munich fans (AP) A Downing Street spokeswoman passed on Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s congratulations to Kane on Tuesday. When asked about a potential knighthood, she stated: "I think everyone would agree, Harry Kane has given an enormous amount to English football, and this is a very special moment for him and the country, but, as ever, I’m not going to pre-empt the honours process." Kane's remarkable 73-goal tally across last season earned him the accolade from French publication France Football, making him the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001. He joins Stanley Matthews, Bobby Charlton, Kevin Keegan and Owen as the only English winners of the prestigious trophy. Kane watched from the bench on Wednesday night as his Bayern team-mates secured a 6-1 victory in their cup clash. Reflecting on the whirlwind experience, he said: "So much has happened in 48 hours. It was nice to kind of be back a bit in normality, seeing the fans, getting the reception before the game. "It’s been a whirlwind of a 48 hours, and it’s nice to just be here and feel at home."

item.title: France to bid for UEFA Nations League Final Four hosting rights
item.description: France to bid for UEFA Nations League Final Four hosting rights France are considering a bid to host the 2026-2027 UEFA Nations League Final Four, French FA president Philippe Diallo has revealed to Ouest-France . For their bid to go through, Zinédine Zidane’s Les Bleus must first qualify for the competition’s semi-finals. So far, they’re on course with three wins and one draw in their four opening games against Türkiye, Belgium and Italy. Next month, France cap their Nations League group stage with an away game against Italy, and a home tie against Türkiye. Should they overcome their opponents in two-legged quarter-finals in March, France would qualify for Final Four, and the latter could be held on home soil. “ France are bidding to host the Nations League Final Four next June, should they qualify “, Diallo said to Ouest-France . The games would be played from June 9 to June 13. As for the grounds poised to host the four games – two semi-finals, a Bronze final and the final – the outlet understands that Saint-Etienne’s Stade Geoffroy-Guichard and Lyon’s Groupama Stadium would be elected. Should UEFA pick France to host the Nations League Final Four, it would be the first time the confederation trusts France for the organisation of a major continental event since the disastrous 2022 Champions League final held at Saint-Denis’ Stade de France. GFFN | Bastien Cheval

item.title: The Curious Case of the Chicago Bears Rushing Attack
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Chicago Bears still lead the NFL in rushing. That makes it easy to miss what has happened over the last three games. After averaging nearly 200 rushing yards through their first four contests, the Bears gained a combined 295 yards on the ground against the Packers, Falcons and Patriots . That is fewer than 100 per game. They remain atop the league at 154.3 yards per game because their early production was so strong, but their recent pace tells a different story. The Bears have won the last two games anyway. Caleb Williams threw for more than 300 yards against both Atlanta and New England, and Chicago scored 31 and 30 points. But Monday’s trip to Seattle will test how comfortable the offense is when it cannot rely on those passing numbers. The Seahawks held Kansas City to 50 rushing yards in a 20-3 win last weekend. They also made Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs work for everything else. If the Bears cannot regain some consistency on the ground, Williams may face exactly the kind of game Seattle’s defense wants: repeated passing downs against a unit that can rush four and keep defenders in coverage. Mandatory Credit: Mike Dinovo-Imagn Images The three-game dip began when Kyle Monangai left the lineup with a toe injury. His last appearance was against the Jets, when he rushed for 146 yards and two touchdowns on 30 carries. At the time, Johnson said the toe problem was more serious than the team had initially thought and described the running back as week to week. It would be too simple to assign every lost rushing yard to Monangai. The Bears fell behind early in Green Bay, and game flow can change how often a team runs. Their opponents’ blocking and play calls have varied across the three games, too. Still, the timing matters. Monangai gives Chicago a different runner to pair with D’Andre Swift and lets Johnson distribute carries across the game. Roschon Johnson has taken on more work in his absence, while the Bears signed Zavier Scott to the active roster this week. That is a change from the backfield combination that helped establish the league-leading average. Swift remains productive, but the recent games show how much the Bears are asking of him. He ran 22 times for 78 yards and a touchdown against New England. The veteran has not reached 100 rushing yards in a game since his 124-yard opener against Carolina. That does not mean Swift must produce a 100-yard performance in Seattle, but it certainly does mean Chicago needs more runs that keep the offense on schedule, whether those yards come from Swift, another back or Williams. item.title: Hansi Flick & Barcelona stars hold emergency barbecue to repair squad morale after Real Madrid and PSG defeats
item.description: FC Barcelona v Real Madrid - LaLiga EA Sports 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Barcelona have sought to steady the ship following a turbulent week that saw their momentum halted by painful defeats against PSG and Real Madrid. The first-team squad, alongside Hansi Flick and his technical staff, gathered for an emergency bonding session to restore confidence ahead of a crucial run of fixtures. Barcelona stars unite for emergency bonding session Barcelona have recently experienced heavy burden following back-to-back disappointments against PSG in the Champions League and Madrid in La Liga. Away from the glare of the media and the noise of external criticism, the group gathered at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper following a commercial photography session. The objective was clear: to reclaim their lost sensations, strengthen internal complicity, and solidify a sense of unity before facing a daunting schedule in the coming weeks. This social gathering served as an emotional reset for a squad that had previously felt invincible. As the team looks to move past their recent setbacks, insiders suggest the atmosphere was focused on collective growth. “It is not about erasing what happened, but about assuming it together,” sources at the club explained to Mundo Deportivo . Captain Raphinha leads dressing room response The decision to host a barbecue was not a directive from the board, but rather a player-led initiative designed to keep the group focused. item.title: Detroit Lions Named Potential Destination for 4 NFL Trade Targets
item.description: The Detroit Lions are suddenly being connected to several intriguing names as the November 10 NFL trade deadline approaches. And while Brad Holmes hasn’t pulled the trigger on a major move, a new national trade-deadline analysis suggests Detroit could be an attractive destination for four players who might become available. The list includes two veteran cornerbacks, a former first-round defensive end, and an experienced offensive lineman. But here’s the interesting part: Not all four players would address an equally pressing need for the Lions. Detroit Lions general manager Brad Holmes acknowledges fans during warmups ahead of the game against the Arizona Cardinals at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona on Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Four Trade Candidates Who Could Fit the Detroit Lions In a recent breakdown of the NFL’s top 25 potential trade candidates , Jeremy Fowler and Matt Bowen identified Detroit as a possible landing spot for four players. Those names are: Player Position Current Team Riq Woolen CB Philadelphia Eagles Donte Jackson CB Los Angeles Chargers Shemar Stewart EDGE Cincinnati Bengals Cesar Ruiz G New Orleans Saints The most obvious connection involves Detroit’s secondary, which has struggled throughout much of the season. Woolen, a 6-foot-4 cornerback, would provide the Lions with size and speed on the outside. Although his 2026 performance has been inconsistent, his physical tools could make him an intriguing addition to Kelvin Sheppard’s defense. Jackson offers something different: experience. The 30-year-old has started more than 100 NFL games and recorded 23 career interceptions. His experience in zone coverage could provide Detroit with another dependable option, assuming his health checks out. Both players have been discussed as possible trade candidates, but neither has been confirmed as the subject of active negotiations with Detroit . Could Brad Holmes Make a Bigger Swing? Perhaps the most interesting name is Stewart, Cincinnati’s first-round selection in the 2025 NFL Draft. The former Texas A&M standout has barely played this season, logging only 17 defensive snaps through Cincinnati’s first six games. At 6-foot-5 and 267 pounds, Stewart possesses the kind of size and athleticism that could appeal to Detroit’s defensive staff. But there is one obvious obstacle. Cincinnati invested the 17th overall pick in Stewart just last year, making it difficult to imagine the Bengals giving up on him without receiving a significant return. Ruiz, meanwhile, represents a different kind of possibility. The veteran offensive guard has extensive starting experience, but Detroit already has Tate Ratledge and Christian Mahogany occupying its starting guard positions. Unless Holmes believes an offensive-line upgrade is necessary, Ruiz would appear to be more of a luxury than a priority. item.title: Zaib to leave Northamptonshire after 13 years
item.description: All-rounder Saif Zaib made his debut for Northamptonshire aged 16 in 2014 [Getty Images] Northamptonshire all-rounder Saif Zaib has confirmed that he will be leaving the club following an agreement with "another county". The 28-year-old departs the County Ground, having made more than 200 appearances for Northants, scoring more than 7,300 runs across all formats and helping them to a third T20 Blast title this summer . He made his first-team debut at the age of 16 in a List A match against New Zealand A in 2014, becoming the club's youngest-ever first-team player. He went on to make his First-Class debut the following year against Kent at Canterbury. In a statement, Northampton said they had held discussions with Zaib in an attempt to reverse his decision, but he will be moving on. "It's been a real honour to represent Northamptonshire CCC," Zaib told the club website. "Especially as the club has been such a big part of my life for so long. I'll always be grateful for the memories, friendships and experiences I've had along the way. "To the supporters, thank you from the bottom of my heart for all the love and support you've shown me over the years. It's meant so much to me, and sharing those special moments with you is something I'll always treasure."

item.description: Roma remain interested in Federico Chiesa for January Federico Chiesa is once again a hot name in the Roma transfer market. As the winter transfer window approaches, the Italian winger could leave Liverpool, where he continues to find limited playing time even under Andoni Iraola. According to Fussball-News , the Reds are ready to sell him for around €15 million, a figure that could attract several Serie A clubs. item.description: FILE PHOTO - The moon is seen behind a flag with the Olympic rings. (is associated with: «South Africa's Durban joins race for 2036 or 2040 Olympics») Peter Kneffel/dpa South Africa has chosen Durban as its main candidate city to bid for the Olympic and Paralympic Games in 2036 or 2040. Africa, home of International Olympic Committee president Kirsty Coventry of Zimbabwe, has never hosted sport's most prestigious event. South Africa did host the first men's football World Cup on the continent in 2010. Durban will go up against Munich, India's Ahmedabad, the South Korean region of Jeonbuk, Istanbul in Turkey, Hungary's capital Budapest and Qatar. Any other bidders have until the end of October to submit their plans. The International Olympic Committee is set to select the host city for 2036 in mid-2029. The South African Olympic Committee said at a press conference on Thursday that cities other than main centre Durban could be included in the bid concept. Choosing Durban instead of bigger metropolises such as Johannesburg and Cape Town was a surprise to some Olympic observers. Los Angeles will hold the Summer Games in 2028, with Brisbane following in 2032.

item.title: Steve Kerr coins new nickname for the NBA amid flopping row
item.description: Photo by Matthew Stockman/Getty Images The new NBA season is barely a week old, and Steve Kerr is already fed up with some of the whistles. The league tried to get tough on flopping by letting refs hit guys with technicals, but barely a week into the season, it’s already a total mess. Nobody seems to know what’s getting blown, with refs letting obvious offensive foul-baiting slide while tagging defenders who just took a shoulder to the chest. Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg didn’t hesitate to say the quiet part out loud on opening night, putting Luka Doncic on blast for constantly hunting whistles. Steve Kerr disagrees with officials on the new foul-baiting rule Steve Kerr pulled no punches when asked about the league’s messy crackdown. Instead of backing the way games are being called, he made it clear he’s sick of guys conning the referees, pointing out that the players are constantly grifting while the league runs in circles trying to catch up. Ahead of the Warriors’ win over the Minnesota Timberwolves, he had this to say: “You know my take on the NBA: we should be the ‘No B******* Association.’ That’s another way to say that every bit of b******* the players try to pull, we should just say, ‘No, we’re not doing that.’ It’s a better game when guys aren’t flopping, grabbing, hooking each other, or running into screens and acting like they got hit by a car. “It’s just a better game when the officials have the ability to say, ‘No, we’re not buying into that.’ I feel like as a league, the players are grifting and we’re constantly chasing them, we’re never getting ahead of it. That’s my biggest issue.” Nothing drives coaches and players crazier than a moving target. They’re told flopping is finally getting stamped out, only to watch refs nitpick while some players still get away with flying backward on phantom contact. When the whistle changes from night to night, you just can’t play honest basketball. That actually proved to be the only time Woods won a major with Mike Cowan on the bag, with the boy wonder quickly turning his attention to a dramatic swing change. item.description: (Photo by Kym Illman/Getty Images) | Getty Images When you cover a Formula 1 race on the ground for a week, themes tend to emerge. The week began with a focus on McLaren and “repercussions,” following an incident between teammates — and championship rivals — Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri at the previous race. Norris damaged his front wing on the opening lap in a collision with Piastri, dropping his teammate down the racing order from third to fifth. When the grid arrived in Austin, the focus was on fallout from that incident, and how McLaren would govern the racing between the two drivers. Online abuse of drivers and motorsport figures through social media. PETERSBURG, FLA. — When the final out was made, gloves were thrown in the air, players sprinted to the middle of the infield, and then jumped up and down with one another as well as with the thousands of screaming Brewers fans who had taken over Tropicana Field. In other words, it was time to act like a bunch of kids. And why the heck not? Not only did the Brewers win the first World Series title in franchise history, beating the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 on Wednesday night to clinch the 2026 championship in five games, but they also did it with youth leading the way. Milwaukee catcher William Contreras was a deserving World Series MVP, with everything he contributed with his bat and behind the plate — at the ripe old age of 28. But the Brewers' championship roster, with a payroll in the bottom half of the league, also was built with some true baby faces that include a trio of young stars: starting pitcher Jacob Misiorowski (24), left fielder Jackson Chourio (22) and shortstop Cooper Pratt (22), who all played key roles during the World Series. MORE: How the Brewers built a World Championship roster on a budget The flamethrower Misiorowski picked up the World Series-clinching win in Game 5, throwing 5.2 scoreless innings and allowing just a couple of hits before leaving with a cramp in his right calf. He joined Hall of Famer Tom Glavine as the only pitcher to throw at least 5.0 scoreless innings with two-or-fewer hits allowed in a potential World Series clinching game. He's also the 11th starting pitcher under the age of 25 with multiple wins in a single World Series. Misiorowski is the favorite to win this year’s NL Cy Young award. In the regular season, he had a 16-5 record and a 1.80 ERA, with 252 strikeouts. All those numbers are nice, but Misiorowski is known for one thing: bringing the heat. He set an MLB record for most 100-plus mph pitches thrown in a single game (57) in May. He also became the first pitcher in MLB history to throw more than 1,000 pitches at 100-plus mph in a single season. In Game 1 of the World Series, he set the record for the fastest pitch in the Fall Classic with his first throw of the night, at 103.5 mph. item.title: 'You're going to be a rich f***er;' Bauers, Murphy have amazing moment
item.description: Perhaps one of the most entertaining and touching interactions during the Milwaukee Brewers championship celebration came between first baseman Jake Bauers and manager Pat Murphy, starting when Bauers presented Murphy with the ball that served as the last out of the game . Bauers, of course, was standing on first base when Brice Turang threw over to retire Rays infielder Richie Palacios, the final out that clinched a 4-1 win at Tropicana Field and a World Series triumph , four games to one. "You're going to be a rich f***er," Murphy said with a wry smile to the free-agent-to-be. "Just remember when you're on that horsesh** Yankees team and you guys are all playing for yourselves, just remember, this is the way we used to do it." Jake Bauers gifted last out ball to Pat Murphy 🥹 pic.twitter.com/VIWWKZSBgA — Baseball Is Dead (@baseballisdead_) October 29, 2026 Bauers laughed but shot back, "You ain't getting rid of me that easy." The Brewers will indeed have to pay up to keep Bauers. The NLCS MVP led the team with 26 homers in the regular season, two years removed from signing a minor-league deal with the Brewers. He told the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel the decision to return and eschew retirement hinged largely on the need for health insurance when his wife informed him she was pregnant. He made $2.7 million this season with the Brewers. Bauers, who emerged as one of the team's unofficial spokesmen and philosophers throughout the season, uttered another famous expletive-tinged line when he said in August that the Brewers simply needed to "chill the f*** out a little bit." The Brewers had just gotten swept by San Diego on their way to play four games in Los Angeles against the Dodgers. Milwaukee won three of four in that series in L.A., carried that momentum throughout the rest of the season and then past the same two foes in the postseason . "We get to L.A., win three, and I said, 'This is a damn good baseball team,'" Bauers said during the World Series celebration . "Sometimes it feels like the sky’s falling and it’s just not. And I just knew. We had the right team, we had the right players. It was just crunch time. You could feel it was gonna go in one direction or the other. "I was like, I got to say something. It was off the cuff, man, but I meant it. I meant it. This group was too good to be squeezing so tight. All we had to do was let go and trust each other." Now they're World Series champions, having gone 11-2 in the postseason and suffering both losses by one run apiece. And Bauers, who will have no lack of suitors once free agency begins, was a big part of the process. "I’m most proud of the way the lineup came together and bought into a singular approach," Bauers said. "One through nine. Throughout the entire season, the way they executed, it was f***ing exciting." item.description: Tyrell Shavers played through a torn ACL to help the Buffalo Bills win a playoff game. Then came 290 days on the sidelines. The wide receiver returned to practice Wednesday for the first time since injuring his knee during Buffalo's 27-24 wild-card victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars in January. Shavers was injured on a special teams play in the second quarter and needed help getting off the field. But he returned after halftime and played 22 of Buffalo's 34 offensive snaps in the second half, finishing with one catch for 14 yards. Further testing after the game revealed a torn ACL. Bills quarterback Josh Allen hasn't forgotten what his teammate endured. "He fought through it like a champ," Allen said Wednesday. "He'd rather feel the pain of what he was feeling than not be out there with his teammates." The Bills opened Shavers' 21-day practice window Wednesday, giving the 27-year-old his first opportunity to return to team drills after a long rehabilitation. "It felt great," Shavers said. "Of course you got to knock some rust off, but it just felt good to be back out there with the guys having fun again." The recovery wasn't easy. "It was a long road, up a mountain," Shavers said. "Every day it was almost something new. You achieve something, then it's on to the next thing." Shavers credited Buffalo's training staff for helping him through the process. "So it's been a long road, but it was fun," he said. "Shout out to the staff here. They pushed me every single day to get back here." When will Tyrell Shavers return to the Bills? Shavers' return to practice doesn't mean he's ready to play in a game. The Bills have 21 days to evaluate his recovery and decide whether to activate him to the 53-man roster or revert him to season-ending injured reserve. He was a limited participant Wednesday. Shavers already knows what it takes to get on the roster. He appeared in all 17 regular-season games last year, catching 15 passes for 245 yards and a touchdown while contributing on special teams.
